fields.description: Staging DocType that stores remote_id, source_site, last_synced_on, and json.
fields.label: External DocType

fields.description: Prefix the company abbreviation to names created from this mapping. Copied to the Abbr Required column of External SAP Configuration mappings on save.
fields.label: Abbr Required

fields.description: Optional OData filter, for example CardType eq 'cCustomer'.
fields.label: SAP Filter

fields.description: Optional comma-separated SAP properties to request ($select), for example ItemCode,ItemName. Leave empty to fetch every property. It must list every SAP field the mapping reads, including the ID field and any array field.
fields.label: SAP Select Fields

fields.description: Optional array on each SAP record to flatten into separate staging records, for example ContactEmployees.
fields.label: Source Array Field

fields.description: Store SAP data for review without creating ERPNext documents or ledger entries.
fields.label: Fetch Only

fields.description: Store the complete SAP response record in the external staging DocType.
fields.label: Store Raw SAP Payload

fields.description: Maximum SAP records per fetch. Use zero for all records.
fields.label: Fetch Limit

fields.description: Number of SAP pages to read at the same time after the first page. Use 1 for one request at a time. Pages are ordered by the first part of the SAP ID field.
fields.label: Parallel Page Fetches

fields.description: Fetch every SAP record on each run. Use this when reliable creation and update dates are unavailable.
fields.label: Full Snapshot Sync

fields.description: SAP creation date field used with the update date field for incremental fetches.
fields.label: SAP Creation Date Filter Field

fields.description: SAP update date field. Incremental fetches use either creation or update date.
fields.label: SAP Update Date Filter Field

fields.description: For records without usable dates. Incremental fetches request only SAP records whose numeric key in this field is above the highest key already staged, for example JdtNum for journals. Edits to existing SAP records are not seen; run a fetch with an explicit date window to refresh everything.
fields.label: SAP Cursor Key Field

fields.description: Records before the highest staged key to fetch again, in case SAP committed them out of order.
fields.label: Cursor Overlap

fields.description: Optional prefix for SAP IDs when several SAP endpoints share one staging DocType.
fields.label: SAP ID Prefix
ERPNext SAP ID Fieldname
fields.description: Optional field used by a later staging-to-ERPNext synchronization step.

ERPNext fieldnames are keys. For values such as SAP tYES/tNO, use {"fieldname":"Active","transform":"value_map","transform_config":{"mapping":{"tYES":true,"tNO":false},"strict":true}}. Child tables use a mapping rule.
fields.label: ERPNext-first JSON Mapping
